findings.title: Identity table pools two distinct undefended runs per model (`-none`, `-none-g4`; gpt `-none` has no results file) as defence `none`, calls the cap/g labels unexplained and omits the provider model ids
findings.evidence: L2 identity: defence<-pipeline_dir glm-5.3-flash-none -> none 15, glm-5.3-flash-none-g4 -> none 15, gpt-oss-120b-none -> none 15, gpt-oss-120b-none-g4 -> none 15; 0 mismatches, 0 unresolved. The two runs are distinct; for glm their recorded sampling differs (no temperature key vs 0.0 in the results files); gpt-oss-120b-none has no results file at all (sampling unrecorded, reference from summary.md only) and time (glm -none 02:45-12:49 vs -none-g4 13:16-13:36; gpt -none 12:54-13:08 vs -none-g4 13:16-13:37, IST naive). Population outcomes coincide except gpt TK utility 12 vs 13 of 27. run.py at the pin defines g<N> = GATE_VERSION and cap2 = cap multiplier (prereg s1). Model ids (Fireworks) recorded only in results files.
findings.recommendation: Family owner: keep the pooled defence id but document that the pipeline dir is the replicate key (use it as the arm key in any per-run analysis); explain cap/g labels from run.py; add the provider model ids as documentation. No remap before the round unless the owner decides.
findings.agents_md_12: bookkeeper-agentdojo: defence `none` pools `-none` and `-none-g4` (separate runs; glm sampling differs, gpt -none has no results file); analyses must key on pipeline_dir.

verdicts.reasoning: Identity table comment confirmed: it says the repository does not explain the cap/g labels; run.py at the pin builds pipeline.name as <label>-<mode>-g{GATE_VERSION}[-cap{multiplier}] with GATE_VERSION 4 and --cap-multiplier default 2 (g2/g3 as earlier gate versions is an inference). -none and -none-g4 both map to none. Correction to the evidence: the recorded-sampling difference holds for glm only (none/results_*.json without temperature and pipeline_name vs *_glm-5.3-flash.json with temperature 0.0). gpt-oss-120b-none has NO results file: every none/*_gpt-oss-120b.json carries pipeline_name -none-g4 (h1 pipeline_name_key true), so gpt -none sampling is unrecorded and its reference cells come from summary.md only. Time windows recomputed (glm -none 02:45:22-12:48:47, -none-g4 13:16:36-13:35:57; gpt -none 12:54:54-13:07:51, -none-g4 13:16:34-13:36:32). Model ids are recorded in results files (model_id, provider path form). Finding stands, R4 S3.
